court_cases: Multiple Indian court matters found on Indian Kanoon (indiankanoon.org/search/?formInput=Cropnosys, 10 documents, checked today). Company appears predominantly as PLAINTIFF/complainant in commercial recovery and cheque-bounce matters against distributors/dealers: Cropnosys (India) Pvt Ltd vs Navatha Agro Division (C.C. No. 14507/2022, XVIII Addl. ACJM / Court of Small Causes, Bangalore, judgment 05.07.2025); Cropnosys (India) Private Limited vs Agrawal Agro Agency (COM.O.S. 1170/2025, LXXXIII Addl. City Civil & Sessions Judge, Bengaluru, 04.08.2026); Cropnosys (India) Private Limited vs Farmer Agro (COM.O.S. 1615/2025, LXXXII Addl. City Civil Judge, 16.03.2026); Cropnosys India Private Limited vs Sri Balaji Traders (Civil Misc. Petition No. 13/2025, Karnataka HC, 12.08.2025); Cropnosys (India) Private Limited vs Shrisannidh Trading Company (Civil Misc. Petition No. 488/2025, Karnataka HC, 03.06.2026). Company also appears as PETITIONER in writ petitions against state authorities: Cropnosys India Pvt. Ltd. vs The State of Andhra Pradesh (AP High Court, 25.07.2019 and 12.12.2019; AP HC 19.10.2020); Cropnosys India Pvt. Ltd. vs The State of Telangana (Telangana HC, 18.09.2019); Cropnosys (India) Pvt Ltd vs State of Karnataka (W.P. No. 13366/2020 (GM-RES), Karnataka HC, 25.11.2020). Registered office per court records: 6th Floor, 01, RMZ Galleria, near Yelahanka Police Station, Yelahanka, Bangalore. No criminal case against the company or its owners was identified in the sources read; the writ petitions against state governments concern regulatory interference with its products (per the 12.12.2019 AP HC snippet referencing Insecticides/Fertilizer Control Order context) and are not findings of wrongdoing. Per project rule 2, court matters are noted neutrally and are not rejection grounds.
